sections.name: File setup, hero, control
sections.title: Demo record text and setup
sections.what: Holds the fixed demo records for the first demo case, including a historical land record and a family genealogy note, and the records for the second demo case. Every record is labelled as a synthetic demo and not an official record.
sections.why: Keeps demo content in one place so it is the same each time.
sections.watch_out: Other tests expect specific values in this text, such as the area 1.20 acre, so editing the text can break them.

sections.name: DocumentApplicationService, documentApplicationService
sections.title: Document service methods
sections.what: Provides the service class with seeding, listing, fetching, listing fixtures, attaching a fixture, and preparing a document for extraction. Also exports one shared instance.
sections.why: Gives the rest of the app one entry point for documents.
sections.watch_out: Preparation returns nothing for any document not marked synthetic, which blocks real documents from the extraction path.

summary: Provides the demo land and family documents for each demo case, lists and fetches them, and prepares only synthetic documents for AI text extraction.
purpose: Lets the app show documents for a case and makes sure the demo documents exist before they are read.
why: Likely reason: the demo needs fixed sample records so that the rest of the app can be shown without real government data. Reason for the synthetic-only rule is not stated in the code beyond the flag name.
how: Demo record text is kept in two fixed lists. Seeding writes each demo record to the documents table if missing. Listing seeds first, then reads the case's documents. Fetching finds one document by identifier. Attaching a fixture adds a sample document to a case if the case exists and the fixture is approved. Preparing a document returns its text only if it is marked synthetic.
inputs: Case identifiers, document identifiers, and approved fixture identifiers.
outputs: Document lists and single documents as stored items, and prepared text for extraction.
risks: Every list call also runs seeding, so reads do a little extra work. Only documents marked synthetic are prepared, so real uploads would not reach the extraction step through this path.
debug: If documents are missing for a demo case, check that the seed function ran and the demo case identifier matches. If extraction returns nothing, check whether the document has its synthetic flag set.
